extension.description: Installs and updates the NikeFlix build: verified downloads, clean five-profile installs and no start-up pop-ups.
extension.news: 4.0.0 - NikeFlix next generation (Kodi 21.3): new nikeflix-dist build feed with sha256 verification - Clean install: removes every profile, setting and database (safety backup first) - Installs the build's add-on origin seed and the official-only update settings - Optional Fen 4 fallback installer (from its author, hash-verified) - No start-up pop-ups in any profile; semantic version checks; verified self-update
